videos.description: Pathway to Victory is the broadcast ministry of Robert Jeffress and the First Baptist Church of Dallas; the practical Bible teaching of pastor Jeffress pierces the darkness with the light of God's Word.

videos.title: Discovering the Jewish Jesus With Rabbi Kirt Schneider
videos.description: Messianic rabbi Kirt Schneider, a Jewish believer in Jesus, shares his insights into the Old and New Testaments, provides guidance on prayer and delivers the Word of God.

videos.title: Andrew Wommack: Gospel Truth
videos.description: Andrew teaches that your faith can remain steady despite struggles when you are anchored in Christ and focused on His goodness.

videos.title: Ask the Pastor
videos.description: Bringing together a panel of pastors from various backgrounds and denominations to answer everyone's questions, from a Biblical perspective; viewers can phone, write or email and get their questions answered live on air.

videos.title: Crosstalk
videos.description: The host of CrossTalk is Dr. Randy Weiss. He is a Jewish believer in Jesus who has been proclaiming this message since his conversion in early 1973; tune in weekly to enjoy teaching, humor, singing, and sharing from a Jewish man's perspective; Randy teaches about the Jewish origins of the Christian faith and helps the Church be sensitized to Jewish issues; he is committed to biblical clarity, historical accuracy, and creative techniques for presenting the Gospel message to the mass media.
